articles.title: 'This war must end': UN and Swiss officials hold talks on Sudan conflict
articles.description: On Wednesday the UN special envoy for Sudan, Pekka Haavisto, and Swiss officials opened a new meeting of regional and global powers to help flesh out a plan toward ending the war in Sudan.
